Done. The fix, in `hooks/src/index.js`:

1. **`invokeCleanup` (hooks/src/index.js:462)** now clears `hook._cleanup` before calling it. Previously, a cleanup that threw stayed attached, so when the component was later unmounted the same cleanup was invoked again — throwing a second time and aborting the unmount, which left DOM garbage and skipped the remaining cleanups.

2. **`HookEnvironment.release` (hooks/src/index.js:160)** no longer aborts the whole release loop on the first throwing cleanup. It invokes every remaining cleanup and, afterwards, hands the first error to the nearest error boundary via `options._catchError`.
